# ccm-feedback

> A single-script-tag feedback widget for visual website reviews. Reviewers pin comments on any element of any HTML page, synced live via Supabase (or exported as a JSON file) for handoff to a developer or AI coding agent. Browser-only. No SDK. **Supabase cloud mode is the default install** — the install prompt always sets `data-supabase-url` + `data-supabase-key` (CCM's shared multi-tenant project, isolated per site by a unique `data-project`); localStorage-only mode is an explicit opt-out, not what a plain install produces.

ccm-feedback is a TypeScript widget bundled to a single static JS file (`dist/w.js`, ~30 KB minified). It self-installs from a `<script>` tag, mounts a floating action button on desktop viewports, and persists pinned comments locally or to Supabase. It is a fork of [SitePing](https://github.com/NeosiaNexus/SitePing) (MIT) maintained by [CCM Design](https://ccm.design).

Use this file as the index when reading the project as an AI agent. Each linked file is small enough to fetch in one read.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install via script tag, options, modes (local vs cloud), data model summary, develop/deploy, attribution.
- [docs/self-hosting.md](docs/self-hosting.md): how to host the widget script, the Supabase backend, and the demo page yourself. Migration order, RLS hardening, backups.
- [docs/cloud-mode.md](docs/cloud-mode.md): how `CloudStore` works — PostgREST + Realtime, cache-and-sync writes, project scoping, conflict semantics, localhost auto-disable, failure-mode table.
- [docs/anchoring.md](docs/anchoring.md): four-strategy DOM anchor resolver (id → CSS → XPath → smart scan with fingerprint + text + neighbors), confidence scoring, failure modes.
- [docs/data-model.md](docs/data-model.md): full `AnnotationRecord` schema, the four-status lifecycle (`todo`/`review`/`done`/`question` — agent sets `review`, human flips to `done`), three annotation kinds (target/pin/area), localStorage shape, Postgres shape, export JSON shape, the `/feedback` URL handoff, URL sanitization.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): build pipeline, boot sequence, full module map of `src/`, store contract, event bus, performance notes, what's intentionally out of scope.

## Source

- [src/index.ts](src/index.ts): entry point. Reads `data-*` attrs, mounts widget, picks store (Cloud vs Local), wires events. `sanitizeUrl()` strips sensitive query params.
- [src/types.ts](src/types.ts): `AnnotationRecord`, `CcmFeedbackConfig`, `FeedbackStatus`, `AnnotationKind`, `CapturedElement`. Source of truth for the data model.
- [src/store.ts](src/store.ts): `AnnotationStore` interface + `Store` (localStorage). `buildRecord()`, `normalizePath()`.
- [src/cloud-store.ts](src/cloud-store.ts): `CloudStore` against Supabase PostgREST. Cache-and-sync. Calls `RealtimeClient` for cross-browser updates.
- [src/realtime.ts](src/realtime.ts): raw WebSocket client speaking the Supabase Realtime protocol. No `@supabase/supabase-js` dependency.
- [src/dom/resolver.ts](src/dom/resolver.ts): four-level anchor resolver with confidence scoring (id 1.0 → css 0.95 → xpath 0.9 → scan ≤ 0.85).
- [src/dom/anchor.ts](src/dom/anchor.ts): `generateAnchor()` capture + `rectToPercentages()` math.
- [scripts/feedback.ts](scripts/feedback.ts): Bun CLI — `list`/`get`/`create`/`set-status`/`delete` against Supabase via raw PostgREST (no SDK). Primary: `bun run feedback set-status <id> review` (the agent-loop close). `set-status` accepts `done` for human use; agent-facing surfaces only pass `review`.
- [netlify/functions/feedback.mts](netlify/functions/feedback.mts): `GET /feedback?project=<name>` → `exportAsJson()`-shaped JSON. Anon key from server-side env only, never leaked; read-only; CORS GET. Row→record mapping duplicates `rowToRecord()`.

## Schema

- [supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql](supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql): baseline `ccm_widget_annotations` table + indexes + permissive anon RLS policies. **Required.**
- [supabase/migrations/0002_status_pin_area.sql](supabase/migrations/0002_status_pin_area.sql): adds `status`, `kind`, `pin_x/pin_y`, `area_x/y/w/h`, `captured_elements`. **Required for current build.**
- [supabase/migrations/0003_realtime.sql](supabase/migrations/0003_realtime.sql): enables `supabase_realtime` publication + `replica identity full`. **Required for cloud mode cross-browser sync.**
- [supabase/migrations/0004_status_review.sql](supabase/migrations/0004_status_review.sql): widens the `status` CHECK constraint to add `review` (the agent-loop status). Idempotent, guarded, applied after `0003`. **Required for the apply-feedback loop in cloud mode.**

## Agent prompts

ccm-feedback's DX posture: **the user only ever pastes one prompt.** The orchestrator installs with cloud sync already on by default (CCM's shared Supabase project, isolated by `data-project`) and asks about a dedicated Supabase project + RLS hardening; if the user wants either, the agent `WebFetch`es the corresponding sub-prompt from GitHub and executes it. Sub-prompts exist as files so the orchestrator can fetch them, not so users have to copy them.

- [prompts/install-widget.md](prompts/install-widget.md): **the orchestrator.** This is what the user pastes. Inlines install (framework matrix for Next/Astro/Nuxt/SvelteKit/Remix/Hugo/Rails/Django/static) with the Supabase attributes always included by default, then routes to dedicated-backend / harden sub-flows by raw GitHub URL.
- [prompts/self-host-supabase.md](prompts/self-host-supabase.md): sub-flow. Agent provisions Supabase, runs migrations, wires the script tag, validates cloud sync end-to-end. Refuses service-role key.
- [prompts/harden-rls.md](prompts/harden-rls.md): sub-flow. Agent runs `check-rls.sql` diagnostic, generates a strict policy migration with the operator's project_name allowlist, applies it, re-verifies.
- [skills/apply-ccm-feedback/SKILL.md](skills/apply-ccm-feedback/SKILL.md): installable skill. Auto-triggers on a `…/feedback?project=…` share URL, a raw PostgREST URL, or an exported `ccm-feedback-*.json` payload. Maps each comment to a source file, applies the edit, then sets the handled comment's status to **`review`** via `bun run feedback set-status <id> review` (PostgREST PATCH fallback). **Never sets `done`** — a human verifies in the widget and flips `review`→`done`. `question`/`pin`/`area` items are surfaced, not edited.
- [prompts/apply-feedback.md](prompts/apply-feedback.md): thin human-facing pointer to the skill above (single source of the apply steps, no drift).
- [prompts/README.md](prompts/README.md): explains the one-prompt pattern + the review→edit→review loop. Most users skip this.
- [scripts/apply-migrations.sh](scripts/apply-migrations.sh): plain-bash alternative for users who don't want an agent — `psql` against a Supabase connection string, applies all `supabase/migrations/*.sql` in order.

Raw URLs the orchestrator uses (only the orchestrator fetches these — users don't):
- `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ccmdesign/ccm-feedback-tool/main/prompts/self-host-supabase.md`
- `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ccmdesign/ccm-feedback-tool/main/prompts/harden-rls.md`

## Quick facts for agents

- **Language:** TypeScript (strict + `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`).
- **Runtime:** browser only. No Node runtime, no server.
- **Bundler:** esbuild (`esbuild.config.mjs`). One IIFE bundle, no chunks.
- **Package manager:** Bun 1.3+.
- **Linter / formatter:** Biome.
- **Tests:** none yet. Verification = `bun run check && bun run lint && bun run build` + manual browser smoke test.
- **Mounting:** `<ccm-feedback-widget>` custom host element with open Shadow DOM. Markers/overlay live outside the shadow root so they hit-test against page elements.
- **Mobile:** below 768px the widget is hidden by design; this is a desktop review tool.
- **Cloud mode trigger:** both `data-supabase-url` AND `data-supabase-key` set, AND not running on localhost / `*.local`.
- **localStorage key:** `ccm-feedback:<projectName>`.
- **Postgres table:** `public.ccm_widget_annotations`.
- **Demo:** https://ccm-feedback-582.netlify.app (the page itself runs the widget).
